how_mode_reciprocal_li_3: On match, both commitments start together.
how_mode_free_body: Test someone's app without expecting anything in return.
how_mode_free_li_1: Works even if you have no apps.
how_mode_free_li_3: You still earn points on completion.
how_timeline_lede: Every commitment has 3 checkpoints. Upload one screenshot at each.

how_cp_completed_body: Day 13 to 14. Prove you tested for 14 days.
